title: The Rivergate of the Upper Fly River
author: Ines Vasquez
blurb: Yara Vasquez, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
